chapter: The Paradise and life in Queens
title: Cozy Cole's unsuccessful band and the Candy label date
summary: In 1949 before the Paradise he played in Cozy Cole's band with Joe Wilder and Cecil Payne; it did not catch on, but he arranged and featured on Stardust.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: When was this that you were with Cozy? Was this '46 or something?

It was in that area. No, it was after '46, this was just before I went in the Paradise. Yeah, but the band wasn't successful. We tried and we worked hard but it didn't go over, you know. I think we were a little too ahead of our time,

you know. We made some recordings. I don't even know what happened to them. Yeah. It was on Candy label and I made some arrangements for that date. And my feature on that date was "Stardust". Yeah. Cozy was really tryin' to help me.
